$comment: Hand-edited source of truth. IA.md and matrix.csv are generated from this file by build.mjs. Section sequences were read from the rendered DOM (direct children of <body> and <main>, then one level deeper for large wrappers) of the local mirror at 1440x900; routes are the 12 HTML pages the mirror serves.

meta.mirror: Local static mirror at this folder, served by serve.mjs; byte-identical HTML to the live site except self-hosted Google Fonts.
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill; DOM sequence captured with headless Chromium (Playwright).

categories.CHROME: Page furniture that frames content: skip link, header/bar, mobile menu, footer.
categories.OVERLAY: Hidden-by-default runtime UI opened by a click or timer: modals, lightboxes, viewers, hints.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block: title, positioning line and (on case studies) cover media.
categories.WORK: Blocks that list or showcase projects.
categories.ABOUT: Blocks about the person: skills, personal story, resume content.
categories.CASE: Case-study narrative blocks between the opener and the closing.
categories.CTA: Closing blocks that ask the reader to get in touch or move to another page.

chrome.skip-link.description: Visually hidden 'Skip to content' anchor to #main, revealed on keyboard focus.

chrome.site-header.description: Top header: script-signature logo image linking home, 'My work' and 'Resume' links, a Day/Night theme toggle pill, and a 'Menu' button below the mobile breakpoint.
chrome.site-header.scope: 11 routes: every template except the scrollytelling case study.

chrome.mobile-menu.description: Fixed, hidden-by-default full-screen navigation panel opened by the header's Menu button on narrow viewports.

chrome.site-footer.description: Dark footer: name and role, the 'Let's work together' line, Email / LinkedIn / Resume links, a 'More work' link, and a copyright line.

chrome.story-bar.description: Fixed top bar specific to the scrollytelling case study, with its own theme toggle and a thin reading-progress line above it.

chrome.story-footer.description: Minimal one-line footer (year only) closing the scrollytelling case study.

overlay.lock-modal.description: 'This project is locked' password dialog shown when a locked project row or card is clicked; client-side gate only.
overlay.lock-modal.scope: 2 routes: home and the work index.

overlay.project-box-overlay.description: Fixed overlay that expands a project from the home project box into a larger view.

overlay.desktop-hint.description: Mobile-only dialog ('Drag through my name… open it on desktop'), mounted 500ms after load at widths up to 979px, auto-dismissed after 10s, suppressed for the session once closed.

overlay.booth-viewer.description: Photo viewer with previous/next/close controls for the photo-booth strip in the personal-story intro.

overlay.dreams-modal.description: 'What I'm working towards' modal over a cloud backdrop, opened by the 'A peek into my dreams' button.

overlay.image-lightbox.description: Click-to-enlarge viewer for case-study screenshots; three implementations of the same behaviour.
overlay.image-lightbox.scope: 3 routes: the chaptered, gallery and scrollytelling case studies.

hero.home-intro.description: Home opener: very large display-type name, role line, a three-line positioning statement, a one-line sub, and a 'See my work' arrow link, over a randomised field of short dashes.

hero.work-index-head.description: Work-index opener: the 'Everything I've worked on.' heading with an intro line.

hero.resume-head.description: Resume opener: 'Resume' kicker, name, role, and a contact list (email, phone, LinkedIn).

hero.nda-heading.description: NDA notice opener: 'All work' back link, 'This one is under NDA' title and a short explanation of why the project can't be shown.

hero.case-cover-short.description: Short case-study cover: kicker, title, dek, a meta list and a looping video in a framed stage panel (optional action buttons), leading straight into a single chapter.

hero.case-cover-chaptered.description: Chaptered case-study cover: kicker, title, dek, a meta list and a looping video in a side media panel, leading into a chapter navigation and seven chapters.

hero.case-cover-longform.description: Long-form case-study cover: one-sentence product framing as the title, meta and hero visual.

hero.story-cover.description: Full-viewport scrollytelling opener ('The Doctor Finder') that hands off directly to the story panels.

hero.campaign-cover.description: Gallery case-study cover built around the campaign offer line ('Give ₹500, Get ₹500.').

work.home-work-head.description: Home work intro: 'All work' kicker, 'Problems I've worked on…' heading and a row of skill filter chips.

work.project-box.description: Interactive 'healthcare work box' showcasing projects, with pagination dots, a 'View more work' link and a numbered project index list beneath.
work.project-box.implementedBy: div#pbox.pbx + div.pbx-dots + div.pbx-more + div#pbox-index · js/home-box.js, js/data.js

work.ai-playground.description: 'My AI playground' block: heading plus playable AI-built project cards (e.g. a maths Jenga game) with looping video previews.

work.project-card-stack.description: Vertical stack of 10 large numbered project cards (number · area tag, one-line outcome, thumbnail), revealed on scroll; some link to locked projects.

about.skills-list.description: 'What I do' list of skill areas (0→1 product design, product strategy, AI product design, UX research…), each with a thumbnail or video preview.

about.little-world-intro.description: 'A little world called Ayushi' personal-story opener with a photo-booth strip and craft photos, set on a torn-paper band.

about.diary.description: Paged diary of personal chapters, shown as book spreads with page turning, plus short 'love' notes.

about.to-be-continued.description: Closing personal chapter ('chapter 05 · to be continued…') on a pastel cloud band, with the 'A peek into my dreams' button.

about.resume-experience.description: Resume 'Experience' list: roles with employer, dates and achievement bullets.

case.nda-redacted-art.description: Interactive redacted-page illustration that stays redacted as the cursor moves over it.

case.tldr.description: Summary panel directly under a long-form cover ('The short version' / 'My role').

case.chapter-nav.description: Sticky in-page chapter navigation that tracks the chapter in view.
case.chapter-nav.scope: 3 routes: the chaptered and long-form case studies.

case.chapter.description: Numbered chapter ('01 At a glance', '03 Root cause'…) with heading, prose and figures; repeats with alternating tinted backgrounds on the chaptered page.
case.chapter.scope: 4 routes: one chapter on each short case study, seven on the chaptered one.

case.longform-chapter.description: Long-form chapter group (e.g. #idea, #bets, #system) made of several full-width bands in plain, tinted or dark variants: brief, problem, pains, bets, entry points, pricing tiers.
case.longform-chapter.scope: 2 routes: the long-form case studies (six chapter groups each).

case.scroll-console.description: Scroll-driven walkthrough: a sticky phone/console panel on one side updates as numbered steps ('01 · Booked', '01 · Offer') scroll past on the other.
case.scroll-console.scope: 2 routes: the long-form case studies, inside one chapter group.

case.story-panels.description: Four-panel scrollytelling sequence ('Something's not right. Time to see a doctor.') ending in a one-line hand-off.

case.project-file.description: Project 'file card' summarising the redesign (area, role, timeline) before the narrative starts.

case.story-section.description: Standard narrative section on the scrollytelling page: a short headline ('Clients said it first.') with prose, figures or reveal cards; repeats.
case.story-section.scope: 1 route: the scrollytelling case study (seven instances).

case.network-fork.description: Scroll-stepped diagram with its own step nav showing how two banners split the doctor network, followed by a short summary block.

case.decision-cards.description: 'Six calls that shaped the flow': a run of numbered decision cards, each with its own header, rationale and screens.

case.campaign-brief.description: 'The goal' brief strip under the gallery cover.

case.screen-gallery.description: 'The three screens' gallery: section head plus numbered screen cards (01 · Share …) that open in the lightbox.

cta.nda-walkthrough-ask.description: 'Ask for a walkthrough' prompt with an 'Available on request' line closing the NDA notice.

cta.case-end.description: 'Get in touch' close for chapter-style case studies: invitation line plus a 'Next: <project> →' link.
cta.case-end.scope: 4 routes: the short and chaptered case studies.

cta.longform-final.description: Long-form close: a one-sentence takeaway, a short paragraph, then 'All work' and 'Talk about this project' links.

cta.story-end.description: Scrollytelling close ('That's the booking, sorted') with onward links.

cta.closing-line.description: Single centred line inviting the reader to get in touch.

cta.page-nav-footer.description: Two-link pager: '← Go to home' and a forward link (contact or the next case study).
cta.page-nav-footer.scope: 2 routes: the work index and the gallery case study.

cta.resume-cta.description: Resume close: 'See the designs behind these projects.' with a link to the work.

templates.name: Case study — long-form with scroll console
